description.en:
Places the camera at once, with no movement: sets its position and look-at point (CMND_SET_CAMERA_POS and CMND_SET_CAMERA_REF), and records them as the current and previous point of the camera-control state, so the next CamCtrlMoveTo starts from there.
The camera-control helpers keep their state in subev_ctx.cam_ctrl, the context of an event started by CallEvent. While such an event runs, CallEvent calls sysCamCtrlStep every frame: it applies the engine's camera move (CMND_GET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA) to the camera, keeps the look-at point on the followed character when there is one, and marks the move as finished once it is over (see IsCamCtrlMove).
6-element array [posX, posY, posZ, refX, refY, refZ]: camera position, then the point it looks at.

examples.case: Placing the camera, then moving it slowly (real usage, from ev42120100.nut)
